'''Zard Zell''' was a [[Mimbanese]] getaway [[pilot]] and [[Technician|mechanic]] for the [[Dunn's crew|crew]] of [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]] in the [[Corporate Sector]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. His [[speeder]] was impounded by the [[Corporate Sector Authority]] and he was arrested and placed in a cell with other members of the crew on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]'' in [[132 BBY]].

The crew was able to exploit a flaw in the [[prison ship]]'s [[Variable geometry droid|droid crew]] and caused it to exit [[hyperspace]] in the [[Carlac belt]]. Zell and the others then escaped in an [[escape pod]], but were recaptured and placed in a holding cell in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].

==Biography==
Zard Zell was a [[Mimbanese]] expatriate who worked as part of the [[slicer]] [[Syreth Dunn]]'s [[Dunn's crew|crew]] of [[Thief|thieves]] in the [[Corporate Sector]], acting primarily as the group's getaway [[pilot]] and [[Technician|mechanic]]. However, before Zell had a chance to flex his skills, [[Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]] impounded his [[speeder]] and the Mimbanese was arrested. Due for processing by the [[Detention Task Force]], he was placed on board the [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]] ''[[Palwick]]''<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> in a cell with Dunn and several other members of the crew<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> in [[132 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref>

When the [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya]] was placed into the cell next to the crew, they were impressed by the rumor that she had [[Death|killed]] a [[Jedi]], which was unheard of among the [[prisoner]]s. Dunn attempted to recruit her into a plan to [[Prisoner mutiny on the Palwick|escape]] the [[prison ship]], but when she refused the slicer commenced the plan anyway.<ref name="Lost Found" /> [[Hybroid]] crewmember [[Rott Mercer]] exploited a flaw in the [[starship]]'s [[droid]] crew<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> and deactivated the [[variable geometry droid]] [[pilot]]s, causing the ship to exit [[hyperspace]]<ref name="Lost Found" /> in the [[Carlac belt]]. The [[Shorwilt]] [[Tor Bez'lin]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> then destroyed the [[Unidentified droid warden|warden droid]] and used its [[Limb|arm]] to open the cell holding Zell, Dunn and most of the crew, who piled together into an [[escape pod]],<ref name="Lost Found" /> leaving Aniseya and the incapacitated prisoner [[Melo Tolicus]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> behind.<ref name="Lost Found" />

The crew's escape was short lived and they were captured and placed in a holding cell on the detainment level of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. Held behind a [[force field]], Zell paced back and forth on the cell's bench while Dunn and Bez'lin yelled at the passing [[Jedi Master]] [[Sol]] that the group had not done anything and that the entire [[prison]] break had been Aniseya's idea. Sol then interrogated Tolicus, who had also been captured and placed in a separate cell, and learned the truth of Aniseya's involvement.<ref name="Lost Found" />

==Personality and traits==
Zard Zell was the least technically inclined member of Dunn's crew of lowlifes. He had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and a tough [[Reptile|reptilian]] hide with [[keratin]] scutes that had faded to brown and gray by the [[time]] of the prison break.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
While imprisoned, Zell wore a brown [[Clothing|shawl]], brown pants, a brown [[belt]], and brown insulated driving [[glove]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zard Zell appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The prison ship and Jedi Temple scenes were filmed at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
